newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 12.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 12.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow closed up 5.77 points at 7,085.16, beating Monday's record finish of 7,079.39 ahead of U.S. economic data later this week.

* Indonesian noodle maker PT Indofood Sukses Makmur said on Tuesday the price of a planned series of acquisitions of sister companies had fallen to 1.55 trillion rupiah from the previous 1.75 trillion rupiah "to give more value to public shareholders."
* On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index ended 0.12 points lower at 687.93 points.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,394.25/4.75 at 0135 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,395.80/6.80
* Indofood on reports it had lowered the price of its planned acquisitions of several firms in the Salim Group.
* Timber firm Barito Pacific on market talk the firm was expected to announce rights issue in the near term.
* Bank PDFCI, Bank Papan Sejahtera and Bank Ficorinvest on reports the central bank, Bank Indonesia, planned to sell its stakes in the banks.
* Gudang Garam on reports that a company official allegedly stole 24 billion rupiah.
